testimonials.title: What those who
testimonials.1text: The lot is in a strategic and accessible place, easy access to the paved road by car. Connected to the city and other points of interest. Ideal for a home, farm and outdoor projects.
testimonials.2text: A very simple process, a pleasure doing business with them.
testimonials.3text: I'm very happy with the land, I have several fruit trees and good shade from the pines for my little cabin.
testimonials.4text: The high part of the lot offers a unique view over Almafuerte's green area.
testimonials.5text: I can rate my experience as a lot buyer as excellent! Grateful for the attention and willingness of the owners. Spacious plots, great location, with many possibilities!

faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: All the answers you need to make your decision
faq.a1p1: They are on National Route 4, 3.1 mi from Bonpland and 9.3 mi from Leandro N. Alem (via Almafuerte school, former School 629).
faq.a1p2: Direct access via paved road and internal street.
faq.a2streets: Streets: maintenance of internal roads and shoulder.
faq.q3: Do you have individual title ready to transfer?
faq.a3: Yes, all have individual title and are ready to transfer. We are direct owners with my spouse.
faq.a4p1: This can be by transfer or cash at the notary of choice, and the deposit and land reservation agreement is signed.
faq.a4step2: 2. The notary requests all relevant certificates (title and tax clearances).
faq.a4step3: 3. Transfer is completed after certificates are issued (usually 15-20 days).
faq.a4p2: We work with Lombardi notary in Posadas (Av. Roque Pérez 1615). We can change if the buyer prefers another.
faq.a4li2: Administrative certificates and notary and deed costs
faq.a4li3: Registration fee and purchase deed right
faq.a4li4: Registration fee and usufruct deed right
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5p1: Cash in any currency: Argentine pesos, dollars, guaraníes, reais, USDT, Bitcoin, etc.
faq.q6: Is the area quiet and safe?
faq.a6: Very quiet and safe. It's a very family-oriented rural area, several houses around, school across the street, permanent neighbours.
